column:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production albedo texture, NOT a scene or rendered object.
Create one square image completely filled by TWO edge-to-edge vertical strips of weathered portico column material, equal width, no gutter. They are the TOP and BOTTOM halves of ONE 4.5m tall 0.45m wide square column face, deliberately horizontally stretched in this source. LEFT half: upper 2.25m; RIGHT half: lower 2.25m. All rectangular pixels must contain material. Strict orthographic flat unlit base colour, no perspective, cast shadows, sunlight or background. 
LEFT strip: top 26.7 percent is an ancient restrained rectangular moulded capital, shallow horizontal stone moulding courses, top right corner chipped away revealing darker aggregate. Below that smooth plastered cast-concrete shaft, many small edge chips exposing coarse grey aggregate, a little thin rusted rebar at broken arrises, fine wandering cracks, vertical rain and iron-oxide streaks. RIGHT strip: continued shaft with varied small chips along both arrises, scattered thin rebar in damaged edge patches; lower end gradually darkens with olive damp and patchy pale crustose lichen. Broad quiet intact areas between damage. No one big central unique mark: this face repeats on four sides.
Palette: middle concrete #A49E8C, intact older pale faces #CCC0A2, aggregate recesses #666A5D. Rust #8C4F2E restrained ochre #B5743F; damp grey olive. Decades of subtropical root pressure and rain. Beautiful fine tactile mineral detail, faithful realistic hand-painted survival environment finish. No roots, plants, terrain, bricks, writing, logos, labels, borders, watermark or lighting. Only the two flat surface strips filling the image.
pole:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: flat orthographic unlit albedo surface sheet for original ruined subtropical city.
One square image divided into TWO EQUAL vertical strips, no border or gutter, ALL pixels filled with concrete surface. These are sequential sections of one unrolled 6m concrete utility pole. LEFT is upper 3m of circumference; RIGHT lower 3m. Each strip represents a 0.94m circumference unrolled flat; do not render a round cylinder or object or light the sides. Texture left/right boundaries of EACH strip should be visually alike for wrapping. 
Pale grey warm spun concrete, fine coarse aggregate pores, subtly visible casting rings, thin longitudinal cracks, mottled old lime film, rust streaks. Left strip: two SMALL old bolt holes with thin irregular rusty circular halos well separated down its length, and a small broken corroded iron climbing step stub in lower half. Right strip: weathered surface more chipped and scarred with subtle vertical root contact abrasion, patchy cream crustose lichen, olive damp becoming more present near foot. Most area remains quiet concrete. Pale middle #A49E8C, dry exposed #CCC0A2, damaged aggregate #666A5D, iron corrosion #8C4F2E and muted #B5743F. Natural mineral detail varying from tiny pinholes to chips, no repetitive speckle-only texture. Subdued realistic hand-painted finish. Flat diffuse colour, NO directional illumination or raised bevel shading, NO cast shadows. NO perspective, side shading, tree, ground, branches, big wires, text, branding, labels, margins, vignette, background. Entire image a material surface.
post:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: flat unlit physically based base-colour texture, unrolled steel post surface. Generate square image with two equal vertical rectangular strips, no gutter. LEFT strip upper half and RIGHT strip lower half of ONE ancient 8cm diameter 3.5m long rusted galvanised steel street-sign pipe, surface unrolled flat. Each is deliberately horizontally stretched; no perspective, no cylindrical shading, no object silhouette. Edge-to-edge material, no margins.
Most surface deeply corroded dark brown iron oxide #8C4F2E, flaking scaly corrosion in muted #B5743F and dull dark remaining metal #454A43. Layers of extremely fine rust pits and larger jagged flakes, rain runnels. A narrow patchy horizontal ring of old dull zinc galvanising near upper third of LEFT strip, interrupted heavily by rust. Occasional faint grey-green paint remnants and lichen. RIGHT strip heavily pitted and dark olive damp near foot. No regular repeated horizontal bands. Several elongated splits following vertical seam of rolled pipe but no big holes or machinery. Have abundant quiet fine texture between distinctive peeling spots. Left and right edges each strip should match when wrapped.
Flat uniform diffuse albedo. No highlights, directional lighting, shadows, ambient vignette. Nothing except surfaces, no trees, no floor, no people, no words, numbers, logos, labels, border or watermark. Original realistic authored survival environment texture, no reference to any existing game.
sign:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: flat unlit albedo texture sheet for an ancient street sign.
Square image of TWO rectangular metal surfaces STACKED VERTICALLY. Top half is FRONT of one 0.75 x 0.45m street sign; bottom half its BACK. Both fill their entire half from edge to edge; no borders, margins, background or empty pixels. Perfect front orthographic, absolutely flat diffuse base colour, no perspective or drop shadow. 
Decades of tropical rain have left dented dark rusty steel #8C4F2E with scaly ochre #B5743F patches and #454A43 surviving iron. FRONT: a mostly lost dull green horizontal colour band, remnants of bone-coloured paint, and one heavily eroded simple rightward arrow; barely any original enamel remains, just a ghost. NO WORDS NO LETTERS NO NUMBERS. Rusted edges, pinholes, layered flaking paint islands, fine pits, vertical rain stains, two small mounting holes aligned horizontally across middle. BACK: plain dull rusty steel with TWO SMALL BLACK BOLT HOLES symmetrically positioned left and right at mid height, corroded ring around each, a few dark bare iron patches, quiet fine pits and natural oxidised sheets. Back has no arrow or band. Do not paint any pole or mounting bracket. 
Realistic fine tactile surface with restrained muted colour variation; original authored environment texture, no existing game imagery. Do not give large scale illumination gradient, shine, specular highlights or baked shadows. No sunlight, scene, ground, foliage, watermark, outline, infographic symbols, text or labels.
